implementation.metadata: Plaintext and E2EE image previews carry the source message identifier, author display name, avatar and timestamp into the global viewer.
implementation.zoom: Buttons, mouse wheel and keyboard controls support 100%-400% zoom, reset, and bounded pointer panning. Changing an image resets the viewport.
implementation.gallery: Multiple plaintext image attachments on one message open as a navigable gallery with previous/next buttons, arrow keys, wrapping and a position counter.
implementation.lifecycle: The viewer remains outside virtualized message rows, owns decrypted blob URLs, restores focus, locks body scrolling and preserves native modified-click behavior.

remaining_acceptance: Exercise touch panning and multi-image navigation at every target viewport, confirm focus restoration with the virtualized row removed, and verify access loss/deletion behavior against two real clients.
